messages.subject: ctmm 0.3.5 on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
This release is mostly requested features & bug fixes.
added a FAQ page to the documentation help("ctmm-FAQ")
bugfix in occurrence method for BM & IOU models
unit conversion can now be disabled in summary with units=FALSE argument
added trace option to ctmm.select & bandwidth/akde
improved telemetry error support in summary.ctmm and plot.variogram
as.telemetry more robust to alternative column label capitalizations
ctmm.loglike & ctmm.fit more robust when tau_velocity ~ tau_position
Kalman filter & smoother upgraded to Joseph form covariance updates

messages.subject: alpha version of web app for ctmm
messages.subject_clean: alpha version of web app for ctmm
messages.body_plain:
I'm working on a web app for ctmm package.

There is a beta1 version hosted in cloud <https://ctmm.shinyapps.io/dashboard1/>. You can run it without installation. This beta version is feature complete in every stage, but every stage is very simple.

The current alpha version is hosted in github <https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmm-shiny-prototype>. There are much more features in first 2 stages now, including much more visualization and interactivity. You should be able to run from github directly by following the instructions.

Here is a demo I recorded to show some features of the app <https://youtu.be/7vRktLa76Ho>.
